claim: On the International Space Station, the DOSTEL dosimeters read about 4.5 microgray per hour (median) on 10-12 May 2024.

values.label: ISS DosTel1, 10-12 May 2024, median absorbed dose rate
ISS DosTel2, 10-12 May 2024, median absorbed dose rate

caution: The highest ISS readings in this window (527 and 391 uGy/h at about 11:27 UTC on 10 May 2024) come before the storm reached Earth that evening; they are most likely a pass through the South Atlantic Anomaly. The game uses only the medians.

source.name: NASA OSDR RadLab (Radiation Dosimetry Database), ISS DOSTEL

claim: Astronauts' menus contain between 1,900 and 3,200 calories a day. The ISS receives fresh food every few months; farther from Earth (Moon, Mars), crews will need to grow their own food.

source.name: Canadian Space Agency, Growing healthy food in space and in remote areas (date modified 2026-07-24)
